text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп returns from her quest for
Eden just in
time to make her debut
race. But right before the
race starts,
what should she see but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: A chihuahua through a stick of chikuwa!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I send Голд Шипп off to the race with an
anxious
prayer, wondering if she'll be
able to tap into her
full potential.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
